scenes.title: At the Iron Gate
scenes.summary: Kavya brings tea to the courtyard table as Kabir uses her three simple sentences to break the ice with Dev.

scenes.title: The Wooden Train
scenes.summary: Kabir hands Dev their grandfather's carved wooden locomotive just as childhood piano teacher Sudha steps over to greet them.

scenes.title: Thirty Days on Paper
scenes.summary: Behind the front desk Mohan laments the sale notice while Pratap and Kavya urge him to inspect the second page and ask Kabir.

scenes.title: Lemon Cake and Sharp Eyes
scenes.summary: Enjoying Diya's warm lemon cake, Dev notices the worried faces inside the lobby window and offers help from City Hall.

scenes.title: Page Two, Clause Fourteen
scenes.summary: Examining page two of the letter, Kabir points out Clause 14 protecting historic havelis that serve neighbours daily.

scenes.title: Permanent Keys
scenes.summary: Beaming with relief, Mohan greenlights Diya's morning courtyard café and offers Kavya the permanent front-desk job.

scenes.title: Under the Golden Lanterns
scenes.summary: As evening lanterns glow across the courtyard, Kavya, Sudha, and Dev celebrate the week's unexpected friendships.

scenes.title: Room Nine
scenes.summary: Fetching spare café chairs from the basement, Pratap uncovers a locked cedar box stamped 'Room Nine' and a ninth brass key.
